mapper.insert: insert into query_log(query_text, normalized_query, hit, hit_place, knowledge_id, session_id, response_time, query_time) values(#{queryText}, #{normalizedQuery}, #{hit}, #{hitPlace}, #{knowledgeId},#{sessionId}, #{responseTime}, #{queryTime})
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(knowledge_id) AS knowledgeId, CASE WHEN MIN(knowledge_id) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MIN(hit_place) END AS hitPlace, normalized_query AS normalizedQuestion, COUNT(*) AS queryCount FROM query_log WHERE query_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND hit = 1 AND normalized_query IS NOT NULL AND normalized_query != '' GROUP BY normalized_query ORDER BY queryCount DESC LIMIT 10
